system.description:
You are the brute squad.

Powers/Qualities

Assign one of the dice you rolled at the end of the power source step to the @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.DK1Dj4AZrwDMvF9G]{Strength} power. If you already have @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.DK1Dj4AZrwDMvF9G]{Strength}, either skip it or swap the die with one of your new dice.

Assign one of the remaining dice to any of these powers:

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.D8wlyytUDg2oEbkx]{Density Control}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.fBd3ZqSIUowckCHO]{Leaping}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.fubw8CJu2mXFZJUD]{Signature Weaponry}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.N9hlUuhKZTN6REox]{Size-Changing}

• Select from Athletic powers category

Assign any remaining dice to any of these qualities:

• Select from Physical qualities category

• Select from Social qualities category

Abilities

Gain two of the following Green abilities, each using a different power or quality from the Physical Powerhouse list (including @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.DK1Dj4AZrwDMvF9G]{Strength}):

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.IPB6eWZFzzDr9j8e]{Damage Resistant}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.HvsVJwjnaH7rWRtR]{Frontline Fighting}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.FCVqKVJ3wJ2eoJJi]{Galvanize}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.dH37lJqo53cKcBFQ]{Power Strike}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.cZZWLhJRhEtQDP1L]{Strength in Victory}

Gain one of the above abilities at Yellow, using a different power or quality than your Green abilities.

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.CTVnGKdSvggWJVxE]{Damage Resistant}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.ORy7E29N09dz6B9s]{Frontline Fighting}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.oBQ6K4S07DFRgLN2]{Galvanize}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.BcQLMN3FChkKxVeM]{Power Strike}
